name: How do I identify a replacement property for a 1031 exchange involving a vacation rental?

mainEntity.name: How do I identify a replacement property for a 1031 exchange involving a vacation rental?

acceptedAnswer.text: Identifying a replacement property involves adhering to IRS rules, primarily the 3-property rule or the 200% rule. Under the 3-property rule, you can identify up to three properties of any value. Under the 200% rule, you can identify any number of properties, provided their aggregate fair market value does not exceed 200% of the relinquished property's value. Kelby Contreras assists clients in the Miami, Fort Lauderdale, and Palm Beach areas in identifying suitable like-kind properties that align with these IRS identification requirements and their investment goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Identify replacement properties using the 3-property rule or 200% rule within 45 days of selling your relinquished property.
